1742-1978-3301-3363.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3301-3363.description:
Animate The One Ring using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3605-6867.description:
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying its mana cost, returning Appa from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Dance of the Dead.
Dance of the Dead triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Appa, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dance of the Dead ability, doing nothing.
Cast Dance of the Dead from exile by paying {2}, returning Appa from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Repeat from step 2.

4359-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4359-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that Targets a Creature and Creates Treasure
Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering

1810-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Cackling Counterpart and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Cackling Counterpart, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Cackling Counterpart, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Cackling Counterpart once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.
1810-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

1778-2438-2626-4986.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Memnite.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1355-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-3499.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5645-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5645-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-3192-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
2292-3192-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1309-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
1309-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Salvager of Secrets and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1309-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-4742.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-4742.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

296-3532-5060-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.

Repeat.

57-4235-4846-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-5223.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

14-147-5686.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

147-1465-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-1465-6797.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

454-1978-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
454-1978-4747.description:
Cause Alena to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat from step 2.

392-3532-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

1447-1734-2292.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4659-5365-5494-6260.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-6260.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

969-4053-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
969-4053-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

575-997-5624.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

437-509-2751-4131-5056.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-2751-4131-5056.description:
Activate Neurok Transmuter's first ability by paying {U}, causing Sphinx's Disciple to become an artifact.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

254-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
254-4613-5507.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2 using the Human token instead.

372-3204-4344.description:
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Mysterious Limousine to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Mysterious Limousine enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement until Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Mysterious Limousine and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Lumbering Battlement to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

565-1444-2743.description:
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting Biovisionary.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Biovisionary +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat two additional times, foregoing paying the buyback cost on the final iteration.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

331-2584-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

132-3941-4222.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

549-3764-4050.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pincher, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

202-2656.description:
Cast Lich by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Lich entering the battlefield, causing you to lose life equal to your life total.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each player's life total to become equal to the lowest life total among all players.
